final: SELECT t.riskeval AS status, AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / s.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans s JOIN sites t ON s.zoneref = t.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin <> 0 AND t.riskeval IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.riskeval
